title: MCPTarget
description: Configuration for an MCP server target in AgentGateway, defining a connected MCP tool provider.

name.description: Unique name for this MCP target.

type.description: The connection type for this MCP target.

url.description: URL of the MCP server endpoint.

authentication.description: Authentication configuration for connecting to this MCP server.

tokenRef.description: Reference to the secret containing the authentication token.

tools.description: List of tool names exposed by this MCP target (empty means all tools are available).

allowedClients.description: List of client identifiers permitted to use this MCP target.
